content:
Maya Chen: Heads-up: did a focused bring-up for Spiral-7B yesterday. ran quantization sweep + a small routing/classifier experiment. jotting down the quick read for product/GTN.
Samir Patel: Short summary: ran fp16/int8/int4 across GTN-slice-17 (30k multi-turn + summarization + planning prompts). Also trained a tiny binary classifier to flag 'fail-likely' prompts using prompt features + hashed examples.
Samir Patel: Scorecard (compact):
```
- Spiral-7B-fp16: p95 latency 110ms, normalized quality 0.0 (baseline), unit cost ~ $0.48 / 1k tokens
- Spiral-7B-int8: p95 95ms, quality -1.5 pts, unit cost ~ $0.13 / 1k tokens
- Spiral-7B-int4: p95 82ms, quality -4.6 pts, unit cost ~ $0.038 / 1k tokens
- Spiral-7B-int4+KV-fix: p95 84ms, quality -3.8 pts, unit cost ~ $0.04 / 1k tokens
```
Samir Patel: Key callouts: int4 failures concentrated in multi-step planning and chain-of-thought that relies on token-level precision. the KV-fix (small bookkeeping change) recovers some deltas but not all.
Eli Park: Quick note: classifier trained on 5k labeled prompts (balanced). ROC AUC 0.88 on held-out; threshold tuned to capture ~90% of real regressions while keeping false positives low (~6%).
Anya Koval: Product constraint: GTN wants a default under $0.16/1k tokens but will accept hybrid routing. they want clear fallback rules and a 24h canary.
Zoe Lin: Prefer conservative defaults for user-facing assistant. what's the hybrid suggestion?
Samir Patel: Proposal: default -> int8. Opportunistically serve int4 when classifier says 'low-risk' AND prompt length < 600 tokens AND not in the 'planning' tagset. fallback -> int8 on classifier 'high-risk' OR heuristics; pin fp16 for top 0.5% high-value flows (billing/legal). Expected steady-state cost ~ $0.11/1k tokens with classifier at tuned threshold.
Maya Chen: Anything operational needed to run the classifier online? latency cost?
Eli Park: Classifier is tiny (distil BERT-like) and runs on CPU inference in ~6ms median; we can co-locate with request router. overhead adds ~1-2% to p95. infra impact minimal.
Samir Patel: Canary plan (ops snippet):
```yaml
rollout:
  - 3% -> Spiral-7B-int8 (baseline canary)
  - 3% -> Spiral-7B-int8+classifier-rule (compare decisions)
  - 4% -> Spiral-7B-int4 (classifier-allowed only)
monitors:
  - GTN-quality-score
  - longform-regression-rate (window 1h)
  - classifier-false-positive-rate
  - p95-latency
automations:
  - if longform-regression-rate > 1.0% -> scale-back int4 by 50% and notify @product @ml-oncall
  - if classifier-fpr > 12% -> lower classifier threshold and redeploy
```
CI Bot: sweep artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-eval/spiral7b/quant-sweep-2/; classifier model: s3://redwood-eval/spiral7b/classifier-v1/
Anya Koval: Product asks for two deliverables: 1) 1-pager summary for GTN. 2) sample set of ~150 failure prompts with short human labels. can you deliver?
Samir Patel: I'll export the per-task deltas CSV + failure set by EOD PST. Also adding a small harness to simulate the classifier-routing locally for GTN.
Zoe Lin: Sounds good. If canary metrics look clean after 24h we'll move to ramp. keep the default as int8 until we confirm. :+1:
Maya Chen: Closing this readout. follow-up: open a metrics thread after 24h canary with the same monitors. Thanks team.
